summary: Added court/noise.py with NoiseResult NamedTuple and empirical_null_p implementing the Phipson & Smyth (2010) Eq. (2) add-one p-value, ties via >=, decision pass iff p_hat <= alpha (default 0.05). Fail-closed ValueError guards cover empty/non-1-D/non-finite nulls, non-finite observed, and alpha outside (0,1). Added tests/test_noise.py with the four noise-control.md §8 hand-worked vectors plus guard and boundary cases (11 tests).

files_changed.purpose: NoiseResult and empirical_null_p pure function for noise-control statistic
§8 hand-worked vectors, resolution floor, and fail-closed guard tests
